products.name: The Capstone Tee

images.alt: The Capstone Tee being worn, front view
The Capstone graphic: an upright and an inverted pyramid with an eye between them

products.blurb: The unfinished pyramid, split in two, with the eye sitting between the triangles.
products.story: The unfinished pyramid has been on the back of the US one-dollar bill since 1935. It was first drawn for the Great Seal of the United States in 1782, with the floating capstone and the eye above it. We split it into an upright and an inverted triangle and put the eye between the two.

products.name: Signal Tower Tee

images.alt: Signal Tower Tee being worn, front view
Signal Tower graphic: a broadcast tower inside a signal circle and crosshair grid

products.blurb: A broadcast tower drawn like an old surveillance schematic.
products.story: Whoever owns the tower decides what gets broadcast and who hears it. In the US, licensing of the airwaves has run through the FCC since 1934. The design draws the tower as a recovered schematic, with its broadcast circle and the crosshair grid around it.
